step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard shows a virtual software training architecture on AWS for IHS Markit's Kingdom application. On the left side, an instructor icon connects to AWS CloudFormation. CloudFormation uses a custom resource to trigger an AWS Lambda function, which communicates with AWS Systems Manager. Systems Manager executes commands on an EC2 instance (license server / script runner). The EC2 instance sends a completion signal back to CloudFormation's wait handle and configures the AppStream Image Builder. On the right side, students (multi-person user icon) connect via browser streaming URL to AWS AppStream. AppStream connects to AWS FSx (via session script) and Amazon RDS database for project storage.
